_comment: 构建期由 scripts/generate-changelog.mjs 从 JetBrains Marketplace API 自动重写，手工改动会被覆盖。summaryZh 取对应版本 notes 首条纯文本（≤80 字）；summaryEn 沿用此前的手工翻译，新版本在翻译前与 summaryZh 同文。数据来源 https://plugins.jetbrains.com/api/plugins/33633/updates

updates.summaryZh: 修复 IDEA 2026.2 上预览窗「执行 SQL」提示没有匹配的已配置数据源、点了也执行不了的问题，现在平台侧出错会如实报出原因，不再一律归到方言不匹配
updates.summaryEn: Fixed IDEA 2026.2: "Execute SQL" in the preview window reported no matching configured data source and refused to run — platform-side failures now report the real cause instead of being blamed on a dialect mismatch

updates.summaryZh: 装了 MyBatisCodeHelperPro 等同类插件时，Mapper 双向跳转图标不再和对方的跳转箭头叠在同一行
updates.summaryEn: Mapper two-way jump icons no longer overlap with arrows from similar plugins such as MyBatisCodeHelperPro

updates.summaryZh: 修复 IDEA 2026.1.x 启用 MCP Server 后内置服务对所有客户端不可用、必须卸载插件才恢复的问题
updates.summaryEn: Fixed IDEA 2026.1.x: after enabling the MCP Server the built-in service was unavailable to all clients until the plugin was uninstalled
